L4.title: Exports pivot from the US to China
L4.evidence: 12 months to Aug 2026 vs prior 12: US -14.3%, China +19.0%, EU +12.1%

political_events_tariff.event: US 50% tariff on Brazilian goods takes effect

value.reason: IEEPA 50% voided Feb-2026; current layer is Sec.301 25% + forced-labour 12.5% on only 16.5% (US$6.6bn) of US-bound exports; a Lula deal would carve out more lines, not remove 301
escalation from today's 37.5% layer (exemption list narrowed, 301 rate raised, Magnitsky re-imposition discussed Aug-2026); the 2025 shock is already in the base
301/forced-labour layer lifted in a bilateral deal; recovery capped because 24% of US-bound exports sit under Sec.232 (not country-negotiable) and the 2025 crude drop (-30%) was not tariff-driven
301 remedies tied to Pix/ethanol/digital concessions that Congress/BCB resist; relief partial and slow
US-China truce/soy pledges shift soy share (China share of Brazil soy 75%->69% H1-26) but Brazil re-routed volume (+8% total soy); beef safeguard is already binding for both candidates (baseline)
Australia analogue: ~A$20bn/yr (~14% of its China exports) hit, much re-routed for fungible goods; scaled to Brazil's ~US$100bn China flow and soy/iron-ore fungibility
interim agreement provisionally applied since 1 May 2026 (exports to EU +23.5% May-Aug) + beef relisting after the Sep-2026 antimicrobial suspension
EU beef suspension (US$1.8bn/yr) lasts up to two years; adverse CJEU opinion (2027) unsettles provisional application
Brazil-Argentina diplomatic downgrade (Aug-2026), Chinese cars displacing Brazilian autos (-28% H1-26), US-Argentina deal perforating the CET
since the Nov-2025 truce China's share of Brazil soy fell 75%->69% yet total soy +8% (B11) and soy_exports +15.2% YTD: re-routing works

value.monthly_panel:
SELECT series_id, date_trunc('month', date) AS ym,
       CASE WHEN series_id IN ('brl_usd','brent_usd','focus_fx') THEN avg(value) ELSE max(value) END AS v
FROM v_observations WHERE date <= current_date AND series_id IN ('exports_total','imports_total','exports_to_us','exports_to_china','exports_to_eu','china_export_share','soy_exports','oil_exports','oil_exports_kg','iron_ore_exports','iron_ore_exports_kg','beef_exports','beef_exports_to_china','coffee_exports','sugar_exports','pulp_exports','pulp_exports_kg','niobium_exports','fertilizer_imports','potash_imports','iron_ore_unit_value','oil_export_unit_value','pulp_unit_value','bop_goods_exports','brl_usd','brent_usd','focus_fx','wb/TOT.BRA','wb/DXGSRMRCHNSXD_M.BRA','wb/DXGSRMRCHNSCD_M.BRA','wb/REER_M.BRA','trade_balance')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1
value.annual:
WITH a AS (SELECT year, series_id, value FROM v_annual WHERE is_complete AND series_id IN
 ('exports_total','exports_to_us','exports_to_china','exports_to_eu','soy_exports','oil_exports','iron_ore_exports',
  'beef_exports','coffee_exports','sugar_exports','pulp_exports','niobium_exports','beef_exports_to_china'))
SELECT * FROM a PIVOT (max(value) FOR series_id IN ('exports_total','exports_to_us','exports_to_china','exports_to_eu',
 'soy_exports','oil_exports','iron_ore_exports','beef_exports','coffee_exports','sugar_exports','pulp_exports',
 'niobium_exports','beef_exports_to_china')) ORDER BY year
value.wb_regional: SELECT series_id, year, value FROM v_annual WHERE series_id LIKE 'wb/TX.VAL.MRCH.%' AND year BETWEEN 2014 AND 2023
value.wb_product_class:
SELECT series_id, year, value FROM v_annual WHERE series_id IN ('wb/TX.VAL.FOOD.ZS.UN.BR','wb/TX.VAL.FUEL.ZS.UN.BR',
             'wb/TX.VAL.MMTL.ZS.UN.BR','wb/TX.VAL.MANF.ZS.UN.BR','wb/TX.VAL.AGRI.ZS.UN.BR') AND year>=2019
value.wb_qty_uvi:
SELECT series_id, year, value FROM v_annual WHERE series_id IN ('wb/TX.QTY.MRCH.XD.WD.BR','wb/TX.UVI.MRCH.XD.WD.BR')
               AND year IN (2015, 2024)
value.tot_annual: SELECT year, value FROM v_annual WHERE series_id='wb/TOT.BRA' AND is_complete ORDER BY year
value.gdppc_growth: SELECT year, value FROM v_annual WHERE series_id='wb/NY.GDP.PCAP.KD.ZG.BR' AND is_complete ORDER BY year
value.ttpri: SELECT year, value FROM v_annual WHERE series_id='wb/TT.PRI.MRCH.XD.WD.BR' ORDER BY year
value.fx_annual:
SELECT series_id, year, value FROM v_annual WHERE series_id IN ('wb/TX.QTY.MRCH.XD.WD.BR','wb/PX.REX.REER.BR','wb/TOT.BRA')
             AND is_complete ORDER BY year
value.terms: SELECT president, start, "end" FROM political_terms WHERE start >= '2016-01-01'
value.deforestation:
SELECT series_id, year, value FROM v_annual WHERE series_id IN ('wb/AG.LND.PFLS.HA.BR','wb/AG.LND.FRLS.HA.BR')
               AND year >= 2015 ORDER BY year
